description: Text over background images and gradients: pixel sampling decides what axe leaves for manual review (F8).

mustFind.why: white text over a light photo, worst case under 3:1
white text over a half-light, half-dark photo: the worst case decides, not the best (Review Focus 1)

mustNotFind.why: white text over a dark photo and a dark gradient, worst case 7:1 or more
sampling decides the dark photo and gradient as passing, so nothing is left for manual review
